map.年限平均法：年折旧额 =（购车价 − 残值）÷ 使用年限，残值 = 购车价 ×: Straight-line average method: annual depreciation = (purchase price − residual value) ÷ years of use, residual value = purchase price × residual rate (usually 5% to 10%), book value at the end of year n = purchase price − annual depreciation × n; the double-declining balance method has an annual rate of 2 ÷ years, charging against book value in early years and switching to straight-line in the last two years; the sum-of-years-digits method has an annual rate of remaining years ÷ sum of years, where sum of years = n ×(n + 1) ÷ 2.

map.预计残值 = 原值 × 残值率%。直线法：年折旧额 = (原值 − 残值) ÷: Estimated residual value = original value × residual rate%. Straight-line method: annual depreciation = (original value − residual value) ÷ years of use, equal each year. Double-declining balance method: annual rate = 2 ÷ years of use, charged as book value × rate in early years (residual value not deducted), with the last two years switched to straight-line to amortize the remaining depreciable amount. Sum-of-years-digits method: sum of years = n(n+1)/2, year y depreciation = (original value − residual value) × (n − y + 1) ÷ sum of years, declining year by year.
map.原值 200,000 元、年限 5 年、残值率 5%（残值 10,000 元）：: Original value 200,000 CNY, 5 years, residual rate 5% (residual value 10,000 CNY): the straight-line method gives (200000−10000)/5 = 38,000 CNY per year. The sum-of-years-digits method has a sum of 15, so year 1 = 190000×5/15 ≈ 63,333 CNY and year 5 = 190000×1/15 ≈ 12,667 CNY. The double-declining balance method has a rate of 0.4, so year 1 = 200000×0.4 = 80,000 CNY, declining year by year and switching to straight-line in the last two years to reach residual value.

map.车辆前期技术性能好、后期维修与贬值风险大，双倍余额递减与年数总和法前期多提折旧，: A vehicle performs well early and carries higher repair and depreciation risk later, so double-declining balance and sum-of-years-digits charge more depreciation early, better matching the real pace of economic wear and enabling tax deferral.
map.为什么双倍余额递减法最后两年要转直线？: Why does double-declining balance switch to straight-line in the last two years?
map.该方法按账面净值乘以固定率计提、永不为零，若不转换会使账面价值低于残值；会计准则: The method charges a fixed rate against book value and never reaches zero, so without a switch book value would fall below residual value; accounting standards require amortizing book value down to residual value on a straight-line basis over the remaining years.
